data.name: Sairaj
data.gender_notes: Sairaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sairaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sai' which means 'God' and 'Raj' meaning 'ruler'. The name Sairaj is often given to a boy born in the Hindu community, reflecting the belief in the divine protection of the child. The name Sairaj carries the meaning “Ruler of the sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sairaj usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
